requirement.statement: Editable Document occurrences SHALL receive an owner-local XNL authoring session capability through Scope runtime visibility; multiple Scopes MAY share one explicitly bound session instance, while config, DOM, Presenter state and global registries MUST NOT own or resolve the writer.

case.given: A Document root Scope runtime owns an authoring session capability and a descendant Capsule or Component does not override it.
case.when: The descendant submits a document edit.
case.then: The request SHALL be delivered to the same owner-local session through runtime capability visibility.

case.given: A Document occurrence is opened in view mode, whether or not its host runtime owns an authoring factory.
case.when: The occurrence and descendant Scope/Presenter facets are assembled.
case.then: The factory SHALL NOT be invoked, no facet SHALL expose submit, and any assembly result that leaks proposal/control/session capability SHALL fail closed and roll back.

case.given: An editable Document occurrence is assembled.
case.when: Host and descendant runtime capabilities are inspected.
case.then: The host SHALL retain factory and control ports while root/Capsule/Component edit Scopes receive only the proposal port.
